如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    露露看着突然陷入一片昏暗背景的无言，一脸的古怪。
这人会不会是有病啊？
还是说，这人其实是魔兽化成的人，所以神智不发达呢？
如果是这样的话，那我会被吃掉吗？…
这是仍然衣衫不整的露露，心中的想法，顿时，她也继无言之后，陷入了莫名的担忧中。
嘛…满打满算，哥们我才来到这个世界一个月，一个月的时间升到18级，已经很不错了，没准人家是打小就开始修炼，所以才能升到35级的，嗯…准是这样没错。
秉着阿Q精神，无言这样的安慰自己，重新满状态复活，一脸笑嘻嘻的摸样，好像刚才被击沉的不是他一样。
“呐，露露…”
“哇！不要吃我！”陡然听到无言的声音，露露顿时惊叫了一声，但是说出来的内容却是令人无法忽视。
无言嘴角抽搐了起来，眉毛一跳一跳的，看着眼前受惊般卷成一团的某少女，那刚刚才说着那惊人话语的小女生，无言表示自己淡定不能。
连忙咳嗽了两声，无言一脸严肃的对着露露说道：“那个…小露露，你要知道，虽然你很有‘吃’的价值，但是呢，这个‘吃’呢，也是讲究方法的，我个人认为，至少得是两情相悦，你侬我侬的时候，才能达到‘吃’的地步，现在呢，虽然你看起来很可口，但是我们还没有恋奸情热，所以我不会‘吃’你的，你放心好了！”
原本还一脸担心受怕的露露闻言一阵愕然，她是有点天然没错，但不是弱智，无言都说到了这个份上了，她要是还不知道是什么意思，那就枉为活力四射又早熟的17岁少女了。
露露一跳脚蹦了起来，玉指颤颠颠的指着一本正经的无言，脸上是极度的羞愤。“谁…谁要让你那个…那个‘吃’了！”
无言嘿嘿一笑，看着露露精致的脸蛋，坏坏的说道：“你刚才说的啊，叫我不要‘吃’你。”
“我那是…那是…”露露也不知道该怎么办才好了，难道告诉无言，我刚才以为你是魔兽化身的，准备来吃我的吗？
“好拉好啦。”看够了露露的‘表演’，挥了挥手，无言一脸无趣的说道。
“反正你有着高达35级的级别，还怕我‘吃’了你啊？”
露露闻言再次一愣，只见她疑惑的看着无言，呆呆的说道：“高达35级？什么意思啊？”
无言古怪的看了她一眼，抓了抓脑袋，心中沉思。
难道这异世的分级跟自己系统显示的不同？

“就是你的级别，实力拉！”
露露这才恍然大悟，眼珠子一转，开心的一笑，只见她高兴的拍了拍自己的手，好像刚刚才想起了什么一样。“对丫，我是四阶魔法师，才不怕你呢，呵呵…”
“四阶魔法师？”这回轮到无言疑惑了。
这四阶魔法师，又是哪门子的分类法？
“你不知道吗？”仿佛调转了身份一样，当看到无言一脸疑惑的时候，露露露出了古怪的神情，不过比起刚刚无言露出古怪神情的时候，可爱的多了就对了，而且还夹带了一丝不可置信。
只是一眼，无言就看出了这个问题少女的内心活动，无奈的翻了翻白眼，无言对着露露说道：“嘛…你就当我是刚从深山老家里出来的野人吧，快点跟我说说，这到底是怎么回事。”
“哦…是这样啊…”
看到露露恍然的神情，无言单手抚额，恨不得望天长叹。
他敢拿自己的节操做保证，露露绝对是把他的话当真了！
虽然无言的节操已经没剩下多少了就对了…
在经过露露那天然的，又断断缺缺的说明和无言自己的脑补之后，无言对这个异世算是有了初步的了解了。
如同系统提示的一样，这个世界被称为斯巴利尔世界，是一个由帝国、家族和其它势力统治的世界。
那些零零散散的家族和势力暂且不提，这个世界上最大的势力，当属三大帝国！
西南地域的艾路帝国，北方的巴鲁巴帝国，东南地域的菲尔帝国，而如今无言所身处的巨兽森林，便是位于成三角之势的三大帝国的中央地带！
这个世界有两种令无数人向往的主流职业，战士与魔法师，战士修炼斗气战技，魔法师修炼魔力魔法。
随着修炼与境界的提高，战士和魔法师分为一到九阶，一个战士达到了一阶，那么就是一阶战士，一个魔法师达到了一阶，就是一阶魔法师。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to access the author's copyright complaint fast track. Lulu looked at Wuyan who suddenly fell into a dark background, with a strange look on her face.
Could this person be sick?
Or is it that this person is actually a person transformed from a monster, so his mind is not developed?
If so, will I be eaten? …
This was what Lulu, who was still disheveled, was thinking. Immediately, she became speechless and fell into inexplicable worry.
Well...it's a good deal, bro, I've only been in this world for a month, and it took me one month to reach level 18, which is already very good. Maybe I started practicing since I was a child, so I was able to reach level 35. Well...that must be true.
In the spirit of Ah Q, Wu Yan comforted himself like this and resurrected to full strength with a smile on his face, as if he was not the one who was sunk just now.
"Hey, Lulu..."
"Wow! Don't eat me!" Suddenly hearing the silent voice, Lulu screamed, but the content of what was said was impossible to ignore.
The corner of Wuyan's mouth twitched, and his eyebrows jumped up and down. Looking at the girl curled up in a ball in front of him in fright, the little girl who just said those shocking words, Wuyan expressed that he could not remain calm.
Coughing twice, Wuyan said to Lulu with a serious face: "Well...little Lulu, you have to know that although you are of great value for 'eating', this 'eating' also requires methods. I personally think that only when two people are in love, can we reach the point of 'eating' when you are with me. Now, although you look very delicious, we are not in love yet, so I will not 'eat' you, don't worry!"
Lulu, who originally looked worried and frightened, was stunned when she heard this. She is a bit natural, but she is not mentally retarded. Wu Yan said it to this extent. If she didn't know what it meant, then she would be an energetic and precocious 17-year-old girl.
Lulu jumped up, her jade finger tremblingly pointing at the serious Wuyan, with extreme shame and anger on her face. "Who...who wants you to 'eat' that...that!"
Wu Yan chuckled, looked at Lulu's delicate face, and said mischievously: "What you just said, told me not to 'eat' you."
"I was... that was..." Lulu didn't know what to do. Could she tell Wu Yan that I just thought you were the incarnation of a monster and were going to eat me?
"Okay, okay." After seeing enough of Lulu's 'performance', he waved his hand and said with a bored look on his face.
"Anyway, you have a level as high as level 35. Are you afraid that I will 'eat' you?"
Lulu was stunned again when she heard this. She looked at Wuyan in confusion and said blankly: "Up to level 35? What do you mean?"
Wu Yan glanced at her strangely, scratched his head, and thought deeply.
Could it be that the classification of this other world is different from what is shown in my own system?
"That's your level, you're strong!"
Only then did Lulu suddenly realize. She rolled her eyes and smiled happily. She clapped her hands happily, as if she had just remembered something. "Yeah, I'm a fourth-level magician, so I'm not afraid of you, haha..."
"Fourth level magician?" This time it was Wuyan's turn to be confused.
What kind of classification does this fourth-level magician belong to?
"Don't you know?" As if her identity had been reversed, Lulu showed a strange expression when she saw Wu Yan's confused look, but it was much cuter than when Wu Yan showed a strange look just now, and there was also a hint of disbelief.
With just one glance, Wu Yan saw the inner activities of this troubled girl. He rolled his eyes helplessly and said to Lulu, "Well...just think of me as a savage who just came out of my hometown in the mountains. Tell me quickly what's going on."
"Oh...that's itAh…”
Seeing Lulu's stunned look, Wuyan put one hand on his forehead and wished he could look up to the sky and sigh.
He dared to use his integrity as a guarantee, and Lulu definitely took his words seriously!
Although there’s not much left of Wu Yan’s integrity...
After Lulu's natural but incomplete explanation and Wuyan's own imagination, Wuyan finally had a preliminary understanding of this other world.
As the system prompts, this world is called the Sparir World, a world ruled by empires, families, and other forces.
Putting aside the scattered families and forces for the moment, the largest forces in the world are undoubtedly the three empires!
The Ailu Empire in the southwest, the Baruba Empire in the north, the Phil Empire in the southeast, and the Giant Beast Forest where Wu Yan is now is located in the center of the three empires forming a triangle!
There are two mainstream professions in this world that countless people aspire to, warriors and magicians. Warriors practice fighting skills, and magicians practice magic.
With the improvement of cultivation and realm, warriors and magicians are divided into levels one to nine. A warrior who reaches level one is a first-level warrior, and a magician who reaches level one is a first-level magician.
